Custom build of Termux from `master`, commit [`2db3d2f8`](https://github.com/Knox-0x1-cmd/termux-app/commit/2db3d2f8), with 24 reported issues fixed across three commits. Build ✓ Unit tests ✓ Gradle wrapper validation ✓.

The APKs are debug builds. `apt-android-7` is for Android 7 and later, `apt-android-5` for Android 5–6. Use the `universal` APK if you are unsure which ABI your device needs. SHA-256 checksums are attached as `*_sha256sums`.

---

## Crash and stability fixes

- **#5119** — Paste containing only an `ESC` byte crashed the app. `ByteQueue` now treats zero-length writes as a no-op and rejects invalid offset/length values, and `TerminalEmulator.paste` writes nothing when sanitizing leaves an empty string.
- **#3242** — Some IMEs committing unsupported emoji crashed the app. Lone and invalid surrogates in `TerminalSession.writeCodePoint` are replaced with `U+FFFD`, and `TerminalView.commitText` handles lone low surrogates.
- **#5027, #4725, #4706** — Session list crashed with "The content of the adapter has changed but ListView did not receive a notification". The adapter now keeps a private snapshot with an atomic `updateSessions()`, `getTermuxSessions()` returns a synchronized snapshot, and refreshes are marshalled to the UI thread.
- **#4294** — `KeyboardUtils` catches `RuntimeException` from the system `InputMethodManager`, so a broken ROM can no longer crash the app.
- **#3283** — `TermuxOpenReceiver` catches `SecurityException` from `startActivity`.

## Resource leaks and main-thread I/O

- **#5144** — The `getprop` stream is closed and the process destroyed on all paths, including `IOException`.
- **#5254** — In `termux.c`, `argv`/`envp` are freed on every failure path, JNI string conversions are checked, and per-element local references are deleted.
- **#5092, #5093, #4542** — `FileReceiverActivity` runs the `ContentResolver` query, `openInputStream` and file saving off the UI thread, closes streams, and sanitizes and truncates shared file names, which also blocks path traversal.
- **#5155** — `RunCommandService` processes intents on a single background executor instead of the main thread.

## Behaviour and correctness

- **#3935** — Non-web URI schemes (`sftp`, `smb`, `irc`, `gopher`, `jabber`, `nfs`, `nzblnk`, `rtmp`, `mailto`) are recognised, so shared links open `termux-url-opener` instead of the file editor.
- **#5365** (from PR #5395) — `KEYCODE_SYSRQ` is no longer intercepted, so Print Screen reaches the OS screenshot handler.
- **#5368** (from PR #5378) — `TerminalBuffer.getWordAtLocation` expands into transcript rows, so a wrapped word whose head has scrolled off screen is still returned whole when its tail is tapped.
- **#5357** — `DEL` is ignored in printable text and no longer emitted when `CAN`/`SUB` cancel an escape sequence, so it stops appearing in copied text.
- **#5047** — `FLAG_IMMUTABLE` is set on notification `PendingIntent`s where available.
- **#4420, #4849** — The color-scheme background is used when no session exists yet.

## Tests

Regression tests were added for `ByteQueue`, paste sanitization, URL scheme handling, `DEL` handling and wrapped-word taps.

---

## Release numbering

Releases are plain semantic versions: `v0.118.4`, `v0.118.5`, … `v0.118.9`, then the increment carries over to `v0.119.0`, then `v0.119.1` and so on.
